title: Chickpea Quesadilla
description: A fusion of Mexican flavors with North African spices, this chickpea quesadilla is a unique twist on traditional Mexican cuisine.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together the Algerian Spice Blend and a pinch of salt.
Add the Spice Blend mixture to the chickpeas and stir to combine.
Heat the flatbread in the skillet for 1-2 minutes on each side, until lightly toasted.
Spread 1-2 tbsp of hummus on half of each piece of flatbread.
Top the hummus with a portion of the chickpea mixture, sliced onion, and shredded cheese.
Fold the flatbread in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the flatbread is crispy.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
